03 / GOOD TO KNOW

A few clear
answers.

Start with the essentials. For anything else, get in touch with the support team.

What can I do with Cyberpunk VPN?

Use VPN connection controls, browse server entries, check connection information, run speed tests and review session records. The app also includes browser shortcuts, bookmarks and interface language options.

How do I choose a server?

Open the server list to browse available entries and their displayed country labels and latency indicators, then select an entry for your connection.

What does the speed test show?

The speed test displays download speed, upload speed and ping. Measurements can vary with your network and test conditions. Values shown in the screenshots are examples, not performance guarantees.

Where can I read the privacy policy?

You can read the privacy policy for information about the app’s data practices. For privacy questions, contact the support email below.
